expected_issues.title: Subagent allowlist checked against the top-level agent
expected_issues.description:
The allowlist check uses the mode instructions of the session's last request, which is always the top-level agent, so calls made by a subagent are validated against the top-level agent's `agents:` list instead of the calling subagent's own list.

Subagent requests are not added to the chat model, so getCurrentModeInstructions(sessionResource) never returns the subagent that is actually invoking the tool. Nested calls are therefore authorised (or rejected) with the wrong allowlist: a subagent restricted to a small set of agents can spawn anything the top-level agent allows, and legitimate nested calls are refused. The caller identity must come from the tool invocation (request id), not from the session.
